session_summary: Phase 2: 4 parallel reflection-processor containers shipped 4 surgical edits to src/templates.js without conflicts. voltron-7ky (scrum-master narrow scope guard), voltron-65g (4 Editor managers + Write/Edit removal from shader-artist/asset-manager), voltron-3kd (csharp-dev doctrine + dead Coplay refs repaired), voltron-wg2 (Coplay tool gaps + Agent + STOP-rule enforceability). All [DONE], all acceptance criteria verified, no merge conflicts. Continuing to docs sweep voltron-di9.

agent_feedback.worked_well: All four parallel containers landed clean commits without merge conflicts despite editing the same file. The pre-computed line anchors (~713, ~1815, ~1596, ~2125, ~2356, ~2622) and explicit non-overlapping section boundaries injected into each task description prevented contention. Each agent emitted [DONE] with full acceptance-criteria verification table.
agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Output sizes were so large (1MB-4MB) that scrum-master had to grep tail bytes to find [DONE] lines — couldn't read the persisted output files directly because they exceed the 256KB Read cap. Most of the bulk is JSON-stream noise (cache_creation_input_tokens metadata, tool_use_id, session_id repeated per turn).
agent_feedback.suggested_change: Consider a 'compact' result mode where run_agent_in_docker returns only the structured Progress Trail + last [DONE] line + commit hash + acceptance summary, capped at ~50KB. Full stream-json log already lives in .voltron/logs/ — orchestrator only needs the highlights to verify completion.

overall_notes: Parallel dispatch of 4 file-editing agents on the same source file works reliably when each task's scope is partitioned by line range. The prompt-side coordination (each task lists what other parallel containers are touching, plus 'git pull --no-rebase -X ours' fallback) was sufficient — no fallback needed in practice. bd dolt auto-push failed with 'no common ancestor' on each close, but local close succeeded; dolt sync issue is unrelated to the work.
